location_desc: Stegosaurus fossils have been found in the Morrison Formation of Colorado, Utah, and Wyoming in the USA. It lived in semi-arid environments with seasonal rains and patches of forest during the Late Jurassic period.
fun_facts: Stegosaurus had two rows of large bony plates running along its back — scientists are still not sure exactly what they were for!
Its brain was about the size of a walnut — one of the smallest brains compared to its body size of any dinosaur.
The spikes on its tail, called a 'thagomizer', were used to defend itself from predators.
Stegosaurus was about as long as a bus — around 9 metres from nose to tail.
Despite its tiny brain, Stegosaurus survived for millions of years — proving you don't need to be clever to be successful!

translations.title: Stegosaurus
translations.description: Stegosaurus was a plant-eating dinosaur famous for the two rows of large bony plates on its back and the sharp spikes at the end of its tail. It was about as long as a school bus and lived in North America about 150 million years ago during the Jurassic period.

translations.title: Khủng Long Stegosaurus
translations.description: Stegosaurus là loài khủng long ăn cỏ nổi tiếng với hai hàng tấm xương lớn trên lưng và những cái gai nhọn ở cuối đuôi. Nó dài bằng một chiếc xe buýt trường học và sống ở Bắc Mỹ vào khoảng 150 triệu năm trước trong kỷ Jura.
